scenes.summary: Nick Fury is waiting in the dark of Tony's house and says the words "the Avenger Initiative".
scenes.setsUp: The first stinger Marvel ever ran, and the template for every one since.

scenes.summary: Tony Stark walks into a bar and tells General Ross they're putting a team together.
scenes.setsUp: Ross's long grudge against enhanced people, which he is still carrying as President.

scenes.summary: Agent Coulson pulls over in New Mexico and radios in a crater with a hammer in it.
scenes.setsUp: Thor, and SHIELD quietly cataloguing things it does not understand.

scenes.summary: Selvig is shown the Tesseract by Fury while Loki, unseen, whispers in his ear.
scenes.setsUp: The Space Stone — the first Infinity Stone the films put on the board.

scenes.summary: Fury tells a thawed Steve Rogers the world has moved on, and that he has a mission.
scenes.setsUp: The Avengers.

scenes.summary: The Other presents his failure to a purple figure on a floating throne, who smiles.
scenes.setsUp: Thanos, six years before he takes the field.

scenes.summary: The team eats shawarma in silence.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing. It is a joke, and a good one.

scenes.summary: Tony's entire narration turns out to have been a therapy session with a sleeping Bruce Banner.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing plot-bearing.

scenes.summary: Sif and Volstagg hand the Aether to the Collector, who notes that one Infinity Stone is already in Asgard.
scenes.setsUp: The Reality Stone's route to Thanos, and the Collector as a keeper of dangerous things.

scenes.summary: A Jotunheim beast is still loose on Earth.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing.

scenes.summary: Baron von Strucker has Loki's sceptre and two enhanced prisoners — a boy who moves fast and a girl who does stranger things.
scenes.setsUp: Wanda Maximoff, whose grief later cracks the multiverse wide open.

scenes.summary: Bucky reads his own file at the Smithsonian.
scenes.setsUp: Bucky choosing to go looking for himself.

scenes.summary: The Collector drinks among his ruined collection with Howard the Duck.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing, beyond the joke.

scenes.summary: Thanos opens a vault, takes up the Infinity Gauntlet and says he will do it himself.
scenes.setsUp: Infinity War.

scenes.summary: Hank shows Hope a finished Wasp prototype built for her mother.
scenes.setsUp: The Wasp.

scenes.summary: Cap and Falcon have found Bucky, and agree they cannot call Tony.
scenes.setsUp: Civil War.

scenes.summary: Bucky goes back into cryo in Wakanda, at his own request.
scenes.setsUp: Wakanda as the place the MCU keeps hiding its wounded.

scenes.summary: Peter tests the web-shooter signal Tony built into his suit.
scenes.setsUp: Homecoming.

scenes.summary: Strange offers Thor help finding Odin, on the condition Loki leaves Earth afterwards.
scenes.setsUp: Ragnarok.

scenes.summary: Mordo strips a sorcerer of his magic and says the world has too many sorcerers.
scenes.setsUp: Mordo's turn — still unresolved, and still owed a payoff.

scenes.summary: Ayesha builds a new being in a birthing pod and names him Adam.
scenes.setsUp: Adam Warlock.

scenes.summary: Stakar reassembles the original Ravager team; Kraglin practises with Yondu's arrow; the Watchers walk away from their informant.
scenes.setsUp: The Watchers, who are the reason anyone is narrating the multiverse at all.

scenes.summary: Scorpion tells Vulture he has friends on the outside who want Spider-Man dead.
scenes.setsUp: The Sinister Six that never quite arrived.

scenes.summary: Captain America delivers a PSA about patience.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing. It is a joke at your expense.

scenes.summary: A vast ship pulls alongside the Asgardian refugee vessel.
scenes.setsUp: The opening massacre of Infinity War.

scenes.summary: The Grandmaster surrenders to the Sakaaran revolution and calls it a draw.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing.

scenes.summary: T'Challa tells the UN that Wakanda will open itself to the world.
scenes.setsUp: Wakanda as a world power rather than a secret.

scenes.summary: Bucky wakes in Wakanda; the children call him White Wolf.
scenes.setsUp: Infinity War.

scenes.summary: Fury and Hill turn to dust; Fury's pager finishes sending its signal.
scenes.setsUp: Captain Marvel.

scenes.summary: Scott is in the quantum realm when the team pulling him out is dusted, stranding him.
scenes.setsUp: Endgame's entire plan — the quantum realm as the road back.

scenes.summary: An empty house and an emergency broadcast.
scenes.setsUp: The scale of the snap.

scenes.summary: Carol answers Fury's page and walks into Avengers HQ asking where he is.
scenes.setsUp: Endgame.

scenes.summary: Goose coughs the Tesseract onto Fury's desk.
scenes.setsUp: Where the Space Stone was hiding.

scenes.summary: Mysterio's doctored footage frames Peter for murder, and J. Jonah Jameson broadcasts his name.
scenes.setsUp: No Way Home, and therefore the multiverse.

scenes.summary: Talos and Soren have been standing in for Fury and Hill all film.
scenes.setsUp: Secret Invasion.

scenes.summary: Wanda, alone in a cabin, reads the Darkhold while her astral form works — and hears her children calling.
scenes.setsUp: Multiverse of Madness, and the search that drives it.

scenes.summary: Sharon Carter, pardoned and reinstated, sells government secrets as the Power Broker.
scenes.setsUp: A traitor still in place inside the US intelligence apparatus.

scenes.summary: A TVA handbook is stamped: Loki will return in season two.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing narrative — but the Sacred Timeline is already broken by this point.

scenes.summary: Yelena visits Natasha's grave; Valentina points her at the man she blames — Clint Barton.
scenes.setsUp: Hawkeye, and Val quietly assembling the Thunderbolts.

scenes.summary: Wong brings Shang-Chi and Katy to Banner and Carol; the rings are broadcasting a signal to something.
scenes.setsUp: The rings' true origin, still unanswered.

scenes.summary: Xialing has taken over the Ten Rings rather than dissolving it.
scenes.setsUp: Her own war.

scenes.summary: Eros and Pip the Troll arrive to help the missing Eternals.
scenes.setsUp: Thanos's brother, loose in the MCU.

scenes.summary: Dane Whitman reaches for the Ebony Blade as Blade's voice warns him off.
scenes.setsUp: The Black Knight, and Blade.

scenes.summary: Harrow is collected by Jake Lockley, a third alter Marc did not know he had.
scenes.setsUp: Khonshu still having a hand on the wheel.

scenes.summary: Clea opens an incursion in the street and tells Strange he caused one, and is coming to fix it.
scenes.setsUp: An incursion — the exact event Doomsday is built around — named on screen and left unresolved.

scenes.summary: Pizza Poppa's fingers finally stop punching him.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing.

scenes.summary: Kamala's bangle swaps her with Carol Danvers.
scenes.setsUp: The Marvels.

scenes.summary: Zeus sends Hercules to kill Thor.
scenes.setsUp: A grudge nobody has collected on.

scenes.summary: Jane arrives in Valhalla and is welcomed by Heimdall.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing.

scenes.summary: Elsa Bloodstone is cornered by Man-Thing, who is only playing.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing.

scenes.summary: Nakia introduces Shuri to Toussaint — T'Challa's son, raised in Haiti.
scenes.setsUp: The next Black Panther, and the reason the mantle stays in the family.

scenes.summary: Eddie Brock is pulled home, leaving a piece of the symbiote behind in a bar.
scenes.setsUp: Venom in this universe.

scenes.summary: A full trailer for Multiverse of Madness.
scenes.setsUp: The incursions.

scenes.summary: A council of thousands of Kangs convenes; He Who Remains was the one holding them back.
scenes.setsUp: The variant war — the shape the Doomsday conflict inherited when Kang was written out.

scenes.summary: Loki and Mobius watch Victor Timely lecture in 1901.
scenes.setsUp: Loki season two.

scenes.summary: A new Guardians team forms under Rocket.
scenes.setsUp: A team that has not been seen since.

scenes.summary: The Legendary Star-Lord will return.
scenes.setsUp: A promise, not a scene.

scenes.summary: Monica wakes in a bed beside Beast — in a universe that is not hers, where the X-Men exist.
scenes.setsUp: Mutants as a neighbouring reality, which is exactly the Incursion setup.

scenes.summary: Wilson Fisk heads back to New York, already being told he should run for mayor.
scenes.setsUp: Daredevil: Born Again.

scenes.summary: Archive footage of the Fox Marvel era plays over Deadpool insisting those films mattered.
scenes.setsUp: The Fox universe as a real, mourned timeline — the well Doomsday's cast is drawn from.

scenes.summary: Billy sets out to find his brother, with Agatha's ghost attached to him.
scenes.setsUp: Wiccan, and the Young Avengers bench.

scenes.summary: Samuel Sterns tells Sam Wilson to enjoy his world while it lasts — visitors from other worlds are coming.
scenes.setsUp: The clearest in-universe warning of an incursion yet given.

scenes.summary: A tease for the Punisher's own outing.
scenes.setsUp: More Frank Castle.

scenes.summary: The team is rebranded, over their objections, as the New Avengers.
scenes.setsUp: Who holds the Avengers name when Doomsday starts.

scenes.summary: Fourteen months later, a ship bearing the Fantastic Four's mark enters this universe from another.
scenes.setsUp: The single most direct on-ramp to Doomsday in the whole run.

scenes.summary: Parker Robbins' benefactor makes Riri an offer, and he is not subtle about what he is.
scenes.setsUp: Mephisto, in the MCU, making deals.

scenes.summary: Four years on, Franklin is approached in the Baxter Building by a masked figure in green.
scenes.setsUp: Doom, arriving for the child who can rewrite reality.

scenes.summary: An animated Fantastic Four sting.
scenes.setsUp: Nothing.

scenes.summary: A crowd chants for En Sabah Nur as he raises pyramids with his mind.
scenes.setsUp: Apocalypse.

scenes.summary: Deadpool, in a bathrobe, promises Cable will be in the sequel.
scenes.setsUp: Cable.

scenes.summary: Deadpool steals Cable's time device and undoes the film's damage — and a few of Ryan Reynolds' career choices.
scenes.setsUp: Time travel as something the Fox films did too, which the TVA later had opinions about.
